description: Gotham G3 fixture F8 (agent modality — single-tool selection + deterministic count). Alice's enrolled face is injected THREE times on one camera the same day (0, +2h, +4h), so re-ID collapses them to one person with 3 distinct visits. The Detective is asked 'how many times has Alice been seen', which should drive ONE counting tool (presence_count / people_sightings / entity_profile) and report the number. Proves: agent routes to gotham, picks a single sensible read tool, and reports a deterministic count grounded in the pipeline — the simplest end-to-end loop. STAGING-only (LLM-driven): opt-in, never gates. base_capture is NEGATIVE (now-relative, -5h) so the 3 visits stay inside the Detective's now-relative tool windows (last_7d) every run — the count metric is invariant to the absolute base. Media (clips/alice_face.mp4) shared with the graph fixtures, regenerable via local_dev/fetch_eval_clips.sh.
